'''Souverelle''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Yawnelly]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Somnrayna]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "In fairy tales of the bygone era, a princess always waits for the prince to come to the rescue. But in Souverelle's dream world, a princess has all the power needed to hold back an army. Help is welcome, but hardly necessary."

Souverelle is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Souverelle's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Somnrayna]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x6,000) or [[Zobo Shooter]] (Use Bullet Coin x600,000).
* Own 5 Water [[Badge Dojo|Badges]].

==Strategy==
TBA

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Souverelle plays a sleeping princess in naptime stories. The prince is running late, and it's better if he gets lost."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Souverelle is as lovely as a fairytale princess, but always looks sleep-deprived. Tentacles can emit sleep-inducing waves that hypnotize entire areas all around."
